description: Kits (D-092): a template that sets up a deliverable, not only a layer stack: its layers and presets (top first), its charts and page, a methods note for the print, and, for a series, the Changes tool. A layer marked optional is dropped, with its charts, from a build that lacks it (a draft awaiting review); without a required layer the kit is left out. Deadlines link to kits from catalog/deadlines/deadlines.json. Screening, not a regulatory determination (D-041): nothing here is named or designed as a filing.

ms4_watershed.title: MS4 watershed review
ms4_watershed.summary: Stormwater-related listings, aquatic life assessments and TMDLs for the area's subwatersheds, with its outfalls; charts beside the map, and what changed since the 2022 assessment.
ms4_watershed.notes: Methods: subwatersheds (HUC14) touching the area, from NJDEP's final 2022 303(d) list filtered by NJDEP to stormwater-related parameters; general aquatic life assessments by assessment unit from NJDEP's 2024 Integrated Water Quality Assessment, compared with 2022; TMDL areas from NJDEP. Counts are of whole units touching the area.

hazard_mitigation.title: Hazard mitigation plan update
hazard_mitigation.summary: Flood zones and tidal flooding, hospitals, long-term care and schools, Overburdened Communities and, once reviewed, FEMA's National Risk Index by tract; charts beside the map.
hazard_mitigation.notes: Methods: facilities, flood zones and tracts touching the area, from the publishers credited below. National Risk Index ratings compare each tract with all U.S. tracts; they are a screening input to the plan's risk assessment, not a substitute for it.

grant_project_area.title: Grant project area
grant_project_area.summary: The High Injury Network, schools and bus stops over tract poverty and Overburdened Communities, with HUD's low- and moderate-income areas and qualified tracts once reviewed; charts below the map.

charts.title: High Injury Network by road owner

grant_project_area.notes: Methods: features and tracts touching the area, from the publishers credited below. ACS figures are 2020-2024 5-year estimates with margins of error; check each program's own eligibility rules and maps.
